tweets: Price oracle manipulation exploits vulnerabilities in price feeds to alter contract logic, potentially causing unauthorized actions or fund loss.
Remediation requires leveraging multiple decentralized oracles rather than relying on a single data source.
When aggregating data from several sources, reject outliers and anomalous deviations.
Implement time-based defenses using Time-Weighted Average Prices (TWAP) over sufficient windows to resist short-lived manipulations.
Design systems to avoid basing core prices on illiquid pools, as these are more susceptible to manipulation.
Include fail-safe behavior that halts sensitive operations when data is suspicious or unavailable.
